correctness.rationale: Eq. (9) makes the functional exactly \(A\) on the open genuine set and zero on the closed union of bipartition-product varieties. Fixed-cut product states are proper algebraic rank-one loci, so genuine states are dense. Continuity of \(A\) gives continuity on the genuine set and at fully separable states; density plus \(A>0\) gives discontinuity at every other biseparable pure state. The sharp maxima \(2/3\) for \(N=3\) and \(1\) for \(N\ge4\) follow from exact one-qubit entropy bounds and explicit Bell/GHZ product witnesses. No finite experiment is used to justify an infinite statement.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete topological classification, not an isolated example: it identifies every continuity and discontinuity point of a published multipartite entanglement functional and computes the largest possible boundary jump in every dimension with \(N\ge3\). The unit jump for all \(N\ge4\) is mathematically substantive because it shows that the hard genuine-entanglement gate can erase the full available one-qubit entropy continuously approached from genuine states.
